closed_finding.description: Ordinary validation could preserve an already populated unverified release publication_approval. The fix recomputes the artifact gate and requires exact equality before native validation; candidates still reject any publication_approval.

verification.case: ordinary validation rechecks existing publication approval
verification.method: Manifest supplied in memory; gate mocked to an approved artifact-only result to isolate exact metadata comparison. Rejection occurred before native validation or output writes.

conclusion: The reviewed implementation separates byte-specific artifact publication authorization from consumer runtime acceptance. No unresolved substantive code/record finding remains within this review scope. Final release builds, native matching/rebuild checks and GitHub asset verification remain the parent agent responsibility.
limitations: This review did not access N100, alter consumer configuration, log in to services, exercise Voice, restart or reload any service.
This review did not rerun the complete native matching suite or prove the forthcoming final release build.
Authorization and semantic records are maintainer assertions anchored to files and hashes; schema checks do not authenticate human intent or turn text into runtime proof.
